​ According to a statement issued by the Commissioner for Information and Home Affairs, Sanusi Bature, governor Abba Yusuf announced the reforms during the seventh tranche distribution of gratuities and death benefits at the Government House in Kano.
​ Yusuf explained that the new monthly disbursement structure replaces the previous quarterly and intermittent payment system, assuring retired civil servants and families of deceased workers that the government will sustain the regular payouts until all outstanding liabilities are cleared by April 2027.
​ As part of the overhaul, the governor disclosed that the state has fully automated its monthly pension payroll and completed the biometric data capture of retirees to boost transparency and accountability.
​He noted that the new digital verification platform eliminates the financial burden and inconvenience of physical travel, allowing pensioners residing both within Nigeria and in the diaspora to verify their status remotely.
​Consequently, Yusuf urged beneficiaries to download the Kano State Pension Fund Trustees Pensioner Verification Application on the Google Play Store to complete their registration.
​While charging relevant officials to uphold diligence and integrity in executing the new payment schedule, the governor commended the Kano State Pension Fund Trustees, the Office of the Head of Civil Service, the Ministry of Finance, and the Nigeria Union of Pensioners, led by Comrade Godwin Abumisi, for driving the reforms.
